title: ABAproduction
intro: The ’ABAproduction’ component calculates the prod of ABA in soil.

sections.name: none
sections.text:
No ABA production.
   Used by root uptake ABAprod (see 72.1, page 401) .

sections.name: root
sections.desc:
ABA production based on production in roots.
    The assumptions are that that each length of root will produce ABA with a rate
that depends solely on the water pressure in that cell, and that all the ABA will be
included in the water uptake.

attrs.name: expr
attrs.doc:
Expression to evaluate to ABA production per root length [g/cm/h]. The
     symbol ’h’ will be bound to the water pressure [cm].

sections.name: soil
sections.desc: ABA production based on soil location.

attrs.name: expr
attrs.doc:
Expression to evaluate to ABA uptake [g/cm3 /h]. The symbol ’h’ will be
     bound to the water pressure [cm]. The symbol ’L’ will be bound to the
     root density [cm/cm3 ]. The symbol ’S’ will be bound to the water uptake
     [cm3 /cm3 /h].

sections.text:
ABA production based on soil location.
  < soil (expr expr ) >

    expr : number component (see chapter 59)
     Expression to evaluate to ABA uptake [g/cm3 /h]. The symbol ’h’ will be
     bound to the water pressure [cm]. The symbol ’L’ will be bound to the
     root density [cm/cm3 ]. The symbol ’S’ will be bound to the water uptake
     [cm3 /cm3 /h].

sections.name: uptake
sections.desc:
ABA production based on concentration in water uptake.
   The assumption is water uptake from roots in specific region of the soil comes
with a specific ABA concentration, which depends solely on the water pressure in
that region.

attrs.name: expr
attrs.doc:
Expression to evaluate to ABA concentration in water uptake [g/cm3 ]. The
       symbol ’h’ will be bound to the water pressure [cm].
